concepts.description: The provider-agnostic HarnessSession contract: start/send/kill/fork/resume, interrupt vs interruptNative, push/PushOutcome, readLimits, SessionEvent/SessionEventKind, SessionResult, images, pre-send hooks

Per-turn admission and typed turn failures: SessionAttempt, NativeTerminal/NativeOutcome, SessionTurnError, NativeBindingMissingError on a resume with no native conversation; internal TurnState and retainEvidence envelopes
Token accounting: SessionTokens, cache/thinking counters, result totals vs usage events, parseClaudeUsage, codexTokens
Subagent and runtime-task activity on onEvent: SubagentLifecycle, TaskLifecycle, parentToolUseId, unattributedReason (subagent/account-status/task), never part of a turn result
What the package owns vs Foundry/Kingdom, its two dependencies (json-rules, pinned @muse-code/sdk), the Bun runtime pin
Choosing and creating a transport: TRANSPORTS descriptors and declared capabilities, createSession/describeTransport, ACP/API stubs and TransportUnavailableError, runtime roadmap
ClaudeCodeSession over the claude CLI stream-json: control protocol, steer push, extend()/ClaudeSessionExtension, text-only args
ClaudeAgentSdkSession over a caller-supplied Agent SDK query, sdkOptionsFromArgv; no steer, no limit polling
CodexAppServerSession over codex app-server stdio, codexPermissions, the shared JsonRpcConnection; no session fork
MuseSession over muse serve via the pinned @muse-code/sdk, musePermissions, onUserInput questions, XDG isolation, Muse-initiated task events
Deciding whether an agent tool call may run: onToolRequest gates, pre-use vs permission stages, composition (first deny wins), updatedInput, call.signal, per-runtime approval wiring
Keeping secrets from the agent: SecretScratchPad ($$ lift, †references, env/write/pipe/scrub/clear), privatePathGate/privatePathDenial
The PrimedSessions contract: prime/branch/re-prime by primeHash, DecisionRequest/DecisionError settlement, concurrency, hedging, cancellation, onAdmission
CodexPrimedSessions: one app-server per account, thread/fork per cycle, private CODEX_HOME, text-only thread config, service tier
ClaudePrimedSessions: a persisted primed session resumed with --fork-session per cycle, pre-spawned spares
ClaudeSubagentSessions: decision roles as subagents of a dedicated CLI process per group, fan-out batching, side sessions, standby spares
ClaudeInSessionDecisions: decision roles as subagents inside the main ClaudeCodeSession (dispatchers, recycle, orphans, subagent cap)
Account rate limits: LimitSnapshot, per-runtime snapshot parsers, mergeLimits/limitUtilization, probeCodexLimits/probeClaudeLimits without a model turn
Deterministic candidate ranking: strategies (quartile-balanced default), ordering terms, pinned eligibility, allowedBilling, unknownUtilization, exclusion reasons
SubscriptionPool: login instances, leases, health cooldowns, limit refresh, continuity (continueOn), pool events
